svg.title: aws-hoyabit: crypto market analysis agent (hackathon finalist)
svg.desc: Phase A fetches eight sources in parallel with bounded concurrency, and one failing source does not cancel the others. Phase B lets an agent fill gaps until 20% of the time budget remains, then it converges on a report where every claim cites a source. Question-type routing handled 19 of 19 test phrasings with rules alone. Team of four; HOYA BIT track finalist.

g.text: a failed source never cancels the rest
